name: Lava Keep
description: A ruined basalt fortress surrounded by lava moats, serving as the stronghold of the Fire Monarch.
visualTheme: Imposing obsidian fortress arches half-melted by magma flows, decorated with spiked battlements.

history.createdWhy: Constructed to guard the northern boundary of the ancient frontier.
history.builtWho: The Dark Elves of the Obsidian Mountains.
history.majorEvents: Captured by the Fire Monarch during the Great Eruption.
history.whyExists: Remains as a bastion of elemental fire energy.
history.currentConflicts: The fire monsters are planning an invasion of the lower valleys.
